description: Use this whenever you need a password, token, API key or other secret from the user, for example "I will give you my database password" or "you need my API key for X". Never ask the user to type or paste a secret into the chat. Asks the user for one or more secrets and writes them into a .env file or a file, without the values ever passing through this conversation. First call without request_id: returns a link. Show it to the user, then call again with the returned request_id; that call waits for the answer and writes the file with permissions 600. The result only contains names and lengths, never a value.

env_file.description: Write NAME=value lines into this .env file

file.description: Write the single requested value into this file

names.description: Names of the values to ask for, for example ["DB_PASSWORD"]

request_id.description: The id returned by the first call

name: request_secret
